verdicts.note: genuine files fully recompressed and re-encoded by us: AUDIT 0 errors (180 KB file, 2600 objects)

inflight: A second real blocker surfaced in SHIPPED code, not in a probe: R2007 uses two different Reed-Solomon codes — RS(255,239) for the header and system pages, RS(255,251) for data pages — over two DIFFERENT fields, and our encoder used the header generator for both, writing twelve parity bytes off the end of the array. Our own reader ignores parity, so it round-tripped perfectly and nothing caught it. Both generators are now derived rather than transcribed, and whole genuine files recompressed end to end by us audit clean in AutoCAD.
recentlyLanded: RS parity bug fixed: derived both generators from first principles, verified byte-exact on 55189 blocks
Comparison table audited for truth — our own R2007 write claim was false and is corrected
Provenance clean and documented; six gated releases at AUDIT 0/0
